title: OT Security · Telemetry & Anomalies
description: Live telemetry and model alerts persisted through authenticated Node-RED ingestion. No data means no persisted readings, not a healthy sensor.

options.content:
**OT Security Lab** · MQTT TLS → Node-RED validation → InfluxDB → Grafana.

Model alerts are experimental classifications of single readings, not safety decisions. Empty panels or stale timestamps require investigation; the dashboard does not prove the physical process is safe.

targets.query: from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ot_telemetry" and r.kind == "temperature" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ot_telemetry" and r.kind == "humidity" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ot_anomaly" and r._field == "score") |> group() |> count()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ot_telemetry" and r._field == "value") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000.0}))

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ot_anomaly") |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 200) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "device", "kind", "value", "unit", "score", "event_id"])
